question: The Gram Sabha is a meeting of all adults who live in the area covered by a __________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**panchayat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Panchayat:-**

 
• **It refers to the system of local self-government in rural India. **
 
• It is a three-tier system consisting of gram panchayats at the village level, panchayat samitis at the block level, and zilla parishads at the district level.
 
• Panchayats are elected bodies, with members directly elected by the people of the area. They have a wide range of functions, including:
 
 
• **Providing basic services such as drinking water, sanitation, and roads**
 
• **Promoting economic development and employment**
 
• **Protecting the environment and natural resources

 Upholding social justice and equality**
 
 
 
• The Panchayati Raj system was enshrined in the Indian Constitution by the 73rd Amendment Act of 1992. This amendment gave panchayats constitutional status and guaranteed them certain powers and functions.
 
• **The Gram Sabha is a meeting of all adults who live in the area covered by a panchayat.**
